# NUS Newsroom

> The official news hub of the National University of Singapore, showcasing cutting-edge research, academic innovation, and student initiatives across science, technology, and humanities.

NUS Newsroom provides comprehensive coverage of the university's research breakthroughs, educational programs, and community engagement efforts. The site serves as a central resource for media inquiries, press releases, and news reports spanning biomedical engineering, AI education, food science, and social impact initiatives.

## Key Topics

- National University of Singapore (NUS)
- Scientific breakthroughs
- AI education
- Biomedical engineering
- Research highlights
- OpenAI partnership
- Geospatial intelligence
- Food science
- NUS School of Computing
- Pro bono law
- Student initiatives
- Undergraduate education
- Singapore sustainability
- Medical devices
- Interdisciplinary research

## Research & Scientific Breakthroughs

- [Research News](https://news.nus.edu.sg/research): NUS research news hub showcasing scientific breakthroughs and academic innovation
- [What a flex: Swimming robot propelled by lab-grown muscle hits record speed](https://news.nus.edu.sg/what-a-flex-swimming-robot): NUS biomedical engineering breakthrough: lab-grown muscle powers swimming robot
- [NUS scientists show dragon fruit peel extract boosts bread nutrition and lowers glycaemic potential](https://news.nus.edu.sg/dragon-fruit-lowers-glycaemic-potential): NUS food science research on dragon fruit fortification for healthier bread
- [New Centre for Computational Social Science and Humanities at NUS to advance interdisciplinary research on complex societal challenges](https://news.nus.edu.sg/new-centre-for-computational-social-science-and-humanities): NUS launches Centre for Computational Social Science combining AI with humanities

## Academic Programs & Education

- [NUS School of Computing collaborates with OpenAI to develop AI-native graduates](https://news.nus.edu.sg/nus-soc-collabs-with-openai-develop-ai-native-graduates): NUS Computing partners with OpenAI to integrate AI across curriculum
- [NUS to offer Asia's first bachelor's-level geospatial intelligence programme to integrate geospatial data analysis with emerging technologies, artificial intelligence](https://news.nus.edu.sg/nus-to-offer-asias-first-bachelors-level-geospatial-intelligence-programme): NUS launches Asia's first geospatial intelligence degree with AI integration
- [NUS revamps Chinese Studies: New multidisciplinary major and bilingual major launched](https://news.nus.edu.sg/nus-revamps-chinese-studies): NUS launches new Chinese Languages and Cultures and bilingual study majors
- [NUS graduates demonstrate resilience in a cautious job market](https://news.nus.edu.sg/nus-graduates-demonstrate-resilience-in-a-cautious-job-market): NUS graduate employment survey shows strong salaries and job market resilience

## Social Impact & Community Engagement

- [Championing access to justice: NUS Pro Bono Awareness Week connects students with community realities](https://news.nus.edu.sg/nus-pro-bono-awareness-week-2026): NUS Pro Bono Group's awareness week promoting legal education and community outreach
- [Climate adaptation has a new model, made in Singapore](https://news.nus.edu.sg/climate-adaptation-has-a-new-model-made-in-singapore): NUS opinion piece on Singapore's climate adaptation and sustainability strategy
- [What Singapore needs to change to enable better senior living options](https://news.nus.edu.sg/what-singapore-needs-to-change-to-enable-better-senior-living-options): NUS real estate expert opinion on senior living policy and urban planning
